description: This PHP class 'SeoRegex' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Design' manages CRUD operations for SEO regex entries in an Opencart e-commerce system. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve individual, retrieve multiple, and count SEO regex records in the database.
external_files: Database connection and query execution via $this->db
Constants or configuration such as DB_PREFIX

classes.name: SeoRegex
classes.description: A model class for managing SEO regex entries in an Opencart admin module.

methods.name: addSeoRegex
methods.description: Inserts a new SEO regex record into the database with data provided in an associative array.

methods.name: editSeoRegex
methods.description: Updates an existing SEO regex record identified by seo_regex_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteSeoRegex
methods.description: Deletes an SEO regex record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getSeoRegex
methods.description: Retrieves a specific SEO regex record by ID.

methods.name: getSeoRegexes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SEO regex records, optionally filtered with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSeoRegexes
methods.description: Counts the total number of SEO regex records.
